title: Quizzical Dollars
description: Adds a monetary system to Minecraft.
body:
Have you ever wanted to simulate an economy inside Minecraft?
Well now you can! The Quizzical Dollars mod adds an item called "One Dollar". This allows you to simulate currency. Requires Fabric API to work. Get it here: https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api


Note:
_Currently you can only get the item via commands or the creative menu, which helps avoid forgery in servers._
